detail.longDescription: eMudhra are responsible for a lot, sure, but they aren't the ones responsible for scattering an unspecified number of copies of a compromised CA certificate inside all sorts of executable code in my otherwise perfectly up to date system. # python # rust # flatpak # docker # podman and who knows what else, deserve the same fingerpointing meme treatment as eMudhra right now, as far as I'm concerned
